title: 基于溯源分析的LLM智能体对齐保护
summary: 提出ProvenanceGuard，一种基于溯源分析的多阶段管道，在工具执行前检测LLM智能体的三种错位行为。在Agent-SafetyBench和WorkBench上，相比LLM-as-a-judge基线，错误率从42.9%降至1.8%，干预负担从30.5%降至12.8%。
summary_en: Proposes ProvenanceGuard, a multi-stage pipeline based on provenance analysis to detect three types of misalignment in LLM agents before tool execution. On Agent-SafetyBench and WorkBench, error rate drops from 42.9% to 1.8% and intervention burden from 30.5% to 12.8% vs. LLM-as-a-judge baseline.
